sentences.fr: Si je trouvais un appartement moins cher, je déménagerais tout de suite.
sentences.en: If I found a cheaper apartment, I would move right away.
distractors: If I found a bigger apartment, I would move right away.
If I found a cheaper apartment, I would move next year.

sentences.fr: Quand j’aurai mon diplôme, je chercherai un emploi dans une petite entreprise.
sentences.en: When I have my diploma, I'll look for a job in a small company.
distractors: When I have my diploma, I'll look for a job in a big company.
When I got my diploma, I looked for a job in a small company.

sentences.fr: Est-ce que tu accepterais ce poste si le salaire était plus élevé ?
sentences.en: Would you accept that job if the salary were higher?
distractors: Would you accept that job if the salary were lower?
Would he accept that job if the salary were higher?

sentences.fr: Nous espérons que nos enfants pourront étudier à l’université sans emprunter d’argent.
sentences.en: We hope our children will be able to study at university without borrowing money.
distractors: We hope our children will be able to study abroad without borrowing money.
We hoped our children could study at university without borrowing money.

sentences.fr: Je ne resterai pas dans cette ville si je ne trouve rien avant septembre.
sentences.en: I won't stay in this city if I don't find anything before September.
distractors: I won't stay in this city if I don't find anything before November.
I won't leave this city if I don't find anything before September.

sentences.fr: Léa dit qu’elle changera de métier dès qu’elle aura fini sa formation.
sentences.en: Léa says she'll change careers as soon as she has finished her training.
distractors: Léa says she'll change cities as soon as she has finished her training.
Léa says she changed careers as soon as she finished her training.

sentences.fr: Si vous aviez le choix, où iriez-vous vivre l’année prochaine ?
sentences.en: If you had the choice, where would you go and live next year?
distractors: If you had the choice, where would you go and live next month?
If you had the money, where would you go and live next year?

sentences.fr: Mon frère voudrait travailler à l’étranger, mais sa femme préfère rester près de ses parents.
sentences.en: My brother would like to work abroad, but his wife prefers to stay near her parents.
distractors: My brother would like to work abroad, but his wife prefers to stay near her friends.
My brother would like to study abroad, but his wife prefers to stay near her parents.

sentences.fr: On déménagera au printemps, à condition que le propriétaire accepte notre dossier.
sentences.en: We'll move in the spring, provided the landlord accepts our application.
distractors: We'll move in the autumn, provided the landlord accepts our application.
We'll move in the spring, provided the landlord repairs the apartment.

sentences.fr: Si tu veux ce poste, envoie ta candidature avant vendredi et appelle l’entreprise lundi.
sentences.en: If you want that job, send your application before Friday and call the company on Monday.
distractors: If you want that job, send your application before Friday and call the company on Tuesday.
If you want that job, send your application before Monday and call the company on Friday.

sentences.fr: J’aimerais que mes parents viennent vivre plus près de nous l’année prochaine.
sentences.en: I'd like my parents to come and live closer to us next year.
distractors: I'd like my parents to come and live closer to us next month.
My parents would like us to come and live closer to them next year.

sentences.fr: Le travail qu’il a accepté est loin, pourtant il ne veut pas déménager.
sentences.en: The job he accepted is far away, yet he doesn't want to move house.
distractors: The job he accepted is far away, so he wants to move house.
The job he turned down is far away, yet he doesn't want to move house.

sentences.fr: Si nous avions économisé davantage, nous aurions déjà acheté une maison à la campagne.
sentences.en: If we had saved more, we would already have bought a house in the countryside.
distractors: If we had saved more, we would already have bought a house by the sea.
If we had saved more, we would already have rented a house in the countryside.

sentences.fr: Elle va s’installer à Lyon, où son entreprise ouvre un nouveau bureau.
sentences.en: She's going to settle in Lyon, where her company is opening a new office.
distractors: She's going to settle in Lyon, where her company is closing an old office.
Her brother is going to settle in Lyon, where his company is opening a new office.

sentences.fr: Il n’y a que trois candidats pour ce poste, donc j’ai de bonnes chances.
sentences.en: There are only three candidates for this job, so I have a good chance.
distractors: There are only four candidates for this job, so I have a good chance.
There are only three candidates for this course, so I have a good chance.

sentences.fr: Il faut que tu prennes une décision avant la fin du mois, sinon tu perdras l’appartement.
sentences.en: You have to make a decision before the end of the month, or you'll lose the apartment.
distractors: You have to make a decision before the end of the week, or you'll lose the apartment.
You have to make a decision before the end of the month, or you'll lose the job.

sentences.fr: Elle rêve de partir au Canada, mais elle n’en parle jamais à ses collègues.
sentences.en: She dreams of leaving for Canada, but she never talks about it to her colleagues.
distractors: She dreams of leaving for Canada, but she often talks about it to her colleagues.
She dreams of leaving for Canada, but she never talks about it to her parents.

sentences.fr: Ce studio est plus petit que notre appartement, mais son loyer est beaucoup plus cher.
sentences.en: This studio is smaller than our apartment, but its rent is much more expensive.
distractors: This studio is bigger than our apartment, but its rent is much more expensive.
This studio is smaller than our apartment, but its rent is much cheaper.

sentences.fr: Qu’est-ce que vous allez faire si votre demande est refusée ?
sentences.en: What are you going to do if your application is turned down?
distractors: What are you going to do if your application is accepted?
What are you going to say if your application is turned down?

sentences.fr: N’accepte pas ce contrat avant que ton avocat l’ait lu attentivement.
sentences.en: Don't accept that contract before your lawyer has read it carefully.
distractors: Don't accept that contract before your accountant has read it carefully.
Accept that contract before your lawyer has read it carefully.

sentences.fr: Depuis qu’elle a changé de travail, Camille part plus tôt le matin.
sentences.en: Since she changed jobs, Camille leaves earlier in the morning.
distractors: Since she changed jobs, Camille leaves later in the morning.
Since she changed apartments, Camille leaves earlier in the morning.

sentences.fr: Bien que le salaire soit bas, ce stage lui permettra de rencontrer des ingénieurs.
sentences.en: Although the salary is low, this internship will let him meet engineers.
distractors: Although the salary is low, this internship will let him meet journalists.
Although the salary is high, this internship will let him meet engineers.

sentences.fr: Le poste dont je t’ai parlé hier sera libre en janvier.
sentences.en: The job I told you about yesterday will be free in January.
distractors: The job I told you about yesterday will be free in June.
The job I told you about yesterday was free in January.

sentences.fr: Nous allons visiter quatre appartements samedi, mais je doute qu’on trouve le bon.
sentences.en: We're going to visit four apartments on Saturday, but I doubt we'll find the right one.
distractors: We're going to visit five apartments on Saturday, but I doubt we'll find the right one.
We're going to visit four apartments on Sunday, but I doubt we'll find the right one.

sentences.fr: À ta place, je demanderais une augmentation avant de signer le nouveau contrat.
sentences.en: If I were you, I'd ask for a pay rise before signing the new contract.
distractors: If I were you, I'd ask for a pay rise after signing the new contract.
If I were you, I'd ask for a holiday before signing the new contract.

sentences.fr: Ils ne veulent plus vivre en ville, alors que leurs amis rêvent d’y habiter.
sentences.en: They no longer want to live in the city, while their friends dream of living there.
distractors: They no longer want to live in the city, while their friends dream of leaving it.
They still want to live in the city, while their friends dream of living there.

sentences.fr: Tant que je n’aurai pas de réponse, je continuerai à envoyer des candidatures.
sentences.en: As long as I don't have an answer, I'll keep sending applications.
distractors: As long as I don't have an answer, I'll keep sending messages.
As long as I don't have a contract, I'll keep sending applications.

sentences.fr: Combien coûterait un studio près du centre-ville, à ton avis ?
sentences.en: How much would a studio near the city center cost, in your opinion?
distractors: How much would a studio near the station cost, in your opinion?
How much does a studio near the city center cost, in your opinion?

sentences.fr: Si on part en août, on trouvera des billets beaucoup moins chers.
sentences.en: If we leave in August, we'll find much cheaper tickets.
distractors: If we leave in April, we'll find much cheaper tickets.
If we leave in August, we'll find much more expensive tickets.

sentences.fr: Ma mère ne veut pas que je parte avant d’avoir fini mes études.
sentences.en: My mother doesn't want me to leave before I've finished my studies.
distractors: My father doesn't want me to leave before I've finished my studies.
My mother doesn't want me to work before I've finished my studies.

sentences.fr: Ce quartier est moins bruyant que le nôtre et les écoles y sont meilleures.
sentences.en: This neighborhood is less noisy than ours and the schools there are better.
distractors: This neighborhood is noisier than ours and the schools there are better.
This neighborhood is less noisy than ours but the schools there are worse.

sentences.fr: Dans cinq ans, j’espère diriger ma propre entreprise à Bordeaux.
sentences.en: In five years, I hope to be running my own company in Bordeaux.
distractors: In five years, I hope to be running my own company in Toulouse.
In ten years, I hope to be running my own company in Bordeaux.

sentences.fr: Réfléchis bien avant de refuser cette offre ; tu n’en auras pas deux.
sentences.en: Think carefully before turning down that offer; you won't get two of them.
distractors: Think carefully before accepting that offer; you won't get two of them.
Think carefully before turning down that offer; you'll get another one.

sentences.fr: Un ami qui travaille là-bas pourrait t’aider à trouver un logement.
sentences.en: A friend who works there could help you find a place to live.
distractors: A friend who lives there could help you find a place to live.
A friend who works there could help you find a job.

sentences.fr: Il m’a dit qu’il déménagerait en juin, mais rien n’est encore décidé.
sentences.en: He told me he would move in June, but nothing has been decided yet.
distractors: He told me he would move in July, but nothing has been decided yet.
He told me he would move in June, and everything has already been decided.

sentences.fr: Si nous vendons la voiture, nous aurons assez d’argent pour le déménagement.
sentences.en: If we sell the car, we'll have enough money for the move.
distractors: If we sell the car, we'll have enough money for the holidays.
If we sell the house, we'll have enough money for the move.

sentences.fr: Penses-tu qu’il soit prudent de quitter ton emploi sans contrat signé ?
sentences.en: Do you think it's wise to leave your job without a signed contract?
distractors: Do you think it's wise to leave your apartment without a signed contract?
Did you think it was wise to leave your job without a signed contract?

sentences.fr: Nous économisons chaque mois pour que les enfants puissent partir étudier à l’étranger.
sentences.en: We save every month so that the children can go and study abroad.
distractors: We save every week so that the children can go and study abroad.
We save every month so that the children can go and work abroad.

sentences.fr: Si seulement j’avais le courage de tout recommencer ailleurs !
sentences.en: If only I had the courage to start everything again somewhere else!
distractors: If only I had the money to start everything again somewhere else!
If only he had the courage to start everything again somewhere else!

sentences.fr: Elle ne cherche qu’un emploi à mi-temps pour avoir le temps d’écrire.
sentences.en: She's only looking for a part-time job so as to have time to write.
distractors: She's only looking for a full-time job so as to have time to write.
She's only looking for a part-time job so as to have time to travel.

sentences.fr: Mes collègues pensent que je devrais accepter, mais je préfère attendre le printemps.
sentences.en: My colleagues think I should accept, but I'd rather wait for the spring.
distractors: My colleagues think I should accept, but I'd rather wait for the summer.
My colleagues think I should refuse, but I'd rather wait for the spring.

sentences.fr: Appelez l’agence demain matin et demandez si le logement est toujours disponible.
sentences.en: Call the agency tomorrow morning and ask whether the place is still available.
distractors: Call the agency tomorrow evening and ask whether the place is still available.
Call the agency tomorrow morning and ask whether the place is still expensive.

sentences.fr: J’ai déjà envoyé douze candidatures, donc je finirai bien par recevoir une réponse.
sentences.en: I've already sent twelve applications, so I'm bound to get an answer in the end.
distractors: I've already sent twenty applications, so I'm bound to get an answer in the end.
I've already sent twelve messages, so I'm bound to get an answer in the end.

sentences.fr: La ville où nous irons vivre se trouve à deux heures de Paris.
sentences.en: The city where we're going to live is two hours from Paris.
distractors: The city where we're going to live is three hours from Paris.
The village where we're going to live is two hours from Paris.

sentences.fr: Personne ne sait encore où nous habiterons l’année prochaine.
sentences.en: Nobody knows yet where we'll be living next year.
distractors: Nobody knows yet where we'll be living next month.
Everybody already knows where we'll be living next year.

sentences.fr: Si tu te sens fatigué, repousse ton entretien à la semaine prochaine.
sentences.en: If you feel tired, push your interview back to next week.
distractors: If you feel ill, push your interview back to next week.
If you feel tired, push your interview back to next month.

sentences.fr: L’emploi dont il rêvait exige une formation qu’il n’a jamais suivie.
sentences.en: The job he dreamed of requires training he has never done.
distractors: The job he dreamed of requires training he has just finished.
The job he dreamed of requires experience he has never had.

sentences.fr: Vous partirez le trois mars, à condition que vos visas arrivent à temps.
sentences.en: You'll leave on the third of March, provided your visas arrive in time.
distractors: You'll leave on the third of May, provided your visas arrive in time.
You'll leave on the thirteenth of March, provided your visas arrive in time.

sentences.fr: Le plus difficile sera de convaincre mon mari de quitter la région.
sentences.en: The hardest part will be convincing my husband to leave the region.
distractors: The hardest part will be convincing my brother to leave the region.
The hardest part will be convincing my husband to leave his job.

sentences.fr: Si tout se passe bien, on signera le bail avant la fin de la semaine.
sentences.en: If everything goes well, we'll sign the lease before the end of the week.
distractors: If everything goes well, we'll sign the lease before the end of the month.
If everything goes well, we'll visit the apartment before the end of the week.

lines.speaker: Léa
lines.fr: Alors, tu as décidé ? Tu pars vraiment à Nantes en septembre ?
lines.en: So, have you decided? Are you really leaving for Nantes in September?

lines.speaker: Marc
lines.fr: Presque. Mon entreprise m’offre un poste là-bas, avec un meilleur salaire.
lines.en: Almost. My company is offering me a job there, with a better salary.

lines.speaker: Léa
lines.fr: Et Sophie ? Elle accepterait de quitter son travail à Paris ?
lines.en: And Sophie? Would she agree to leave her job in Paris?

lines.speaker: Marc
lines.fr: Elle dit qu’elle chercherait sur place. Elle est prête, si on trouve une école pour Léo.
lines.en: She says she'd look for something once there. She's ready, if we find a school for Léo.

lines.speaker: Léa
lines.fr: Et si vous ne trouvez pas d’école avant l’été ?
lines.en: And if you don't find a school before the summer?

lines.speaker: Marc
lines.fr: Alors nous resterons ici une année de plus. Je n’ai encore rien signé.
lines.en: Then we'll stay here one more year. I haven't signed anything yet.

questions.question: Why is Marc thinking of going to Nantes?
choices: His company is offering him a job there with a better salary.
His wife has already found work there.
His son has a place at a school there.
Flats are cheaper there than in Paris.
questions.explanation: Marc says « Mon entreprise m’offre un poste là-bas, avec un meilleur salaire ».

questions.question: What does Sophie plan to do about work?
choices: Keep her Paris job and travel.
Look for something once they are there.
Ask her company to move her.
questions.explanation: « Elle dit qu’elle chercherait sur place » — she would look for work in Nantes.

questions.question: What does the family still need before they go?
questions.explanation: « Elle est prête, si on trouve une école pour Léo ».

questions.question: What happens if they find no school before the summer?
choices: They stay in Paris one more year.
questions.explanation: « Alors nous resterons ici une année de plus ».

lines.fr: Bonjour, je vous écris au sujet de l’appartement que vous proposez rue Victor Hugo.
lines.en: Hello, I am writing about the apartment you are offering on rue Victor Hugo.

lines.fr: Je commencerai un nouveau travail à Rennes le premier octobre, donc je cherche un logement dès septembre.
lines.en: I'll start a new job in Rennes on the first of October, so I'm looking for a place from September.

lines.fr: Serait-il possible de visiter samedi matin, si le locataire actuel est d’accord ?
lines.en: Would it be possible to visit on Saturday morning, if the current tenant agrees?

lines.fr: Je peux envoyer mon contrat de travail et mes trois dernières fiches de paie.
lines.en: I can send my work contract and my last three pay slips.

lines.fr: Si le loyer reste à huit cents euros, je signerai volontiers la semaine prochaine.
lines.en: If the rent stays at eight hundred euros, I will gladly sign next week.

questions.question: Why does the writer need a place to live?
choices: He is starting a new job in Rennes.
He is going to study in Rennes.
His current flat is too small.
questions.explanation: « Je commencerai un nouveau travail à Rennes le premier octobre ».

questions.question: When does he ask to visit?
questions.explanation: « Serait-il possible de visiter samedi matin » — samedi matin is Saturday morning.

questions.question: What condition does he set before signing?
choices: That the rent stays at eight hundred euros.
That he can move in in September.
That the agency pays the fees.
questions.explanation: « Si le loyer reste à huit cents euros, je signerai volontiers ».

questions.question: What does he offer to send?
choices: His work contract and his last three pay slips.
A letter from his employer in Rennes.
A deposit of eight hundred euros.
questions.explanation: « mon contrat de travail et mes trois dernières fiches de paie ».

lines.speaker: La recruteuse
lines.fr: Bonjour Karim, pourquoi voulez-vous quitter votre poste actuel ?
lines.en: Hello Karim, why do you want to leave your current job?

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.fr: Je fais le même travail depuis six ans et je n’apprends plus rien.
lines.en: I've been doing the same job for six years and I'm not learning anything any more.

lines.speaker: La recruteuse
lines.fr: Et où vous voyez-vous dans cinq ans ?
lines.en: And where do you see yourself in five years?

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.fr: J’aimerais diriger une petite équipe, si j’en ai l’occasion.
lines.en: I'd like to lead a small team, if I get the chance.

lines.speaker: La recruteuse
lines.fr: Le poste commence en mars. Seriez-vous libre à cette date ?
lines.en: The job starts in March. Would you be free on that date?

lines.speaker: Karim
lines.fr: Oui, à condition que mon entreprise accepte de me laisser partir avant mars.
lines.en: Yes, provided my company agrees to let me go before March.

questions.question: Why does Karim want to leave his job?
choices: He is not learning anything any more.
His company is moving to another city.
He does not get on with his boss.
questions.explanation: « Je fais le même travail depuis six ans et je n’apprends plus rien ».

questions.question: What does Karim hope to be doing in five years?
questions.explanation: « J’aimerais diriger une petite équipe ».

questions.question: When does the job start?
questions.explanation: « Le poste commence en mars ».

questions.question: What could stop Karim starting on time?
choices: His company might not let him leave before March.
He has to finish a training course.
He has not signed his new contract.
questions.explanation: « à condition que mon entreprise accepte de me laisser partir avant mars ».

passages.title: A diary entry about changing career

lines.fr: Ce soir, j’ai encore pensé à cette formation d’infirmière dont parle Claire.
lines.en: This evening I thought again about that nursing course Claire talks about.

lines.fr: Si je m’inscrivais en janvier, je devrais travailler le week-end pendant deux ans.
lines.en: If I signed up in January, I would have to work weekends for two years.

lines.fr: Mon mari dit qu’il s’occuperait des enfants le samedi, mais j’ai peur de le fatiguer.
lines.en: My husband says he would look after the children on Saturdays, but I'm afraid of wearing him out.

lines.fr: À quarante ans, changer de métier fait peur ; pourtant je ne veux pas attendre encore dix ans.
lines.en: At forty, changing career is frightening; yet I don't want to wait another ten years.

questions.question: What would she have to do if she signed up in January?
choices: Work at weekends for two years.
Study in the evenings for two years.
questions.explanation: « Si je m’inscrivais en janvier, je devrais travailler le week-end pendant deux ans ».

questions.question: What does her husband offer?
choices: To look after the children on Saturdays.
To ask his boss for shorter hours.
questions.explanation: « Mon mari dit qu’il s’occuperait des enfants le samedi ».

questions.question: How old is she?
questions.explanation: « À quarante ans, changer de métier fait peur ».

questions.question: What is she not willing to do?
choices: Tell her husband about the course.
questions.explanation: « je ne veux pas attendre encore dix ans ».

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.fr: Si on obtenait les visas, tu partirais vraiment à Montréal ?
lines.en: If we got the visas, would you really move to Montreal?

lines.speaker: Thomas
lines.fr: Bien sûr. Mais il faudrait que je trouve un poste avant le départ.
lines.en: Of course. But I'd have to find a job before we leave.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.fr: Ma sœur dit qu’il y a beaucoup de travail là-bas pour les informaticiens.
lines.en: My sister says there's plenty of work there for IT people.

lines.speaker: Thomas
lines.fr: Et pour les professeurs de français ? Tu ne pourrais pas enseigner tout de suite.
lines.en: And for French teachers? You wouldn't be able to teach straight away.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.fr: Je sais. J’accepterais n’importe quel emploi la première année.
lines.en: I know. I'd take any job at all for the first year.

questions.question: What does Thomas say must happen before they leave?
choices: They must find a school for the children.
Sarah's sister must find them a flat.
questions.explanation: « il faudrait que je trouve un poste avant le départ ».

questions.question: What does Sarah's sister say about Montreal?
choices: There is plenty of work there for IT people.
There is plenty of work there for teachers.
Visas are easy to get there.
questions.explanation: « il y a beaucoup de travail là-bas pour les informaticiens ».

questions.question: What does Thomas point out to Sarah?
choices: Her sister would not help them.
She could not teach straight away.
The winters are hard over there.
questions.explanation: « Tu ne pourrais pas enseigner tout de suite ».

questions.question: What is Sarah ready to do in the first year?
questions.explanation: « J’accepterais n’importe quel emploi la première année ».

passages.title: A message about a postponed trip

lines.fr: Salut Marc, je suis désolée : je dois repousser notre projet de voyage.
lines.en: Hi Marc, I'm sorry: I have to put off our trip.

lines.fr: Mon patron m’a proposé une formation en octobre et je ne peux pas la refuser.
lines.en: My boss has offered me a training course in October and I can't turn it down.

lines.fr: Si tout va bien, je serai libre à partir du quinze novembre.
lines.en: If all goes well, I'll be free from the fifteenth of November.

lines.fr: Est-ce que la maison de tes parents serait encore libre à ce moment-là ?
lines.en: Would your parents' house still be free then?

questions.question: Why is she putting off the trip?
choices: Her boss has offered her a training course in October.
She has no money until November.
Her parents are coming to stay.
She has just started a new job.
questions.explanation: « Mon patron m’a proposé une formation en octobre et je ne peux pas la refuser ».

questions.question: From when will she be free?
questions.explanation: « je serai libre à partir du quinze novembre ».

questions.question: What does she ask Marc?
choices: Whether he can come in October.
Whether his parents' house would still be free then.
Whether he will pay for the tickets.
Whether his parents can join them.
questions.explanation: « Est-ce que la maison de tes parents serait encore libre à ce moment-là ? ».

passages.title: A radio announcement about free training

lines.fr: La région ouvrira en septembre trois centres de formation pour les métiers du bâtiment.
lines.en: The region will open three training centers for building trades in September.

lines.fr: Les cours seront gratuits pour toute personne qui cherche un emploi depuis plus de six mois.
lines.en: The classes will be free for anyone who has been looking for a job for more than six months.

lines.fr: Il faudra s’inscrire avant le trente juin sur le site de la région.
lines.en: You will have to sign up before the thirtieth of June on the region's website.

lines.fr: Selon la mairie, quatre cents personnes pourraient commencer dès la première année.
lines.en: According to the town hall, four hundred people could start in the very first year.

questions.question: Who can take the classes for free?
choices: Anyone who has been looking for work for more than six months.
People who already work in building.
questions.explanation: « gratuits pour toute personne qui cherche un emploi depuis plus de six mois ».

questions.question: What is the deadline to sign up?
choices: The end of the first year.
questions.explanation: « Il faudra s’inscrire avant le trente juin ».

questions.question: How many people could start in the first year?
questions.explanation: « quatre cents personnes pourraient commencer dès la première année ».

questions.question: What opens in September?
choices: Three training centers for building trades.
A job centre for the whole region.
questions.explanation: « La région ouvrira en septembre trois centres de formation pour les métiers du bâtiment ».

lines.speaker: Julien
lines.fr: On me propose le poste de chef d’équipe, mais j’hésite encore.
lines.en: They're offering me the team leader job, but I'm still hesitating.

lines.speaker: Nadia
lines.fr: À ta place, je demanderais d’abord combien d’heures tu devras faire.
lines.en: If I were you, I'd first ask how many hours you'll have to do.

lines.speaker: Julien
lines.fr: Le salaire augmenterait de dix pour cent seulement.
lines.en: The salary would go up by only ten percent.

lines.speaker: Nadia
lines.fr: Alors refuse, à moins que tu aies vraiment envie de diriger les autres.
lines.en: Then turn it down, unless you really want to lead other people.

lines.speaker: Julien
lines.fr: C’est justement ça qui me plaît. Je vais accepter.
lines.en: That's exactly what I like about it. I'm going to accept.

questions.question: What is Julien offered?
questions.explanation: « On me propose le poste de chef d’équipe ».

questions.question: What does Nadia advise him to ask first?
choices: How much the salary goes up.
How many hours he will have to work.
Who will be on his team.
questions.explanation: « je demanderais d’abord combien d’heures tu devras faire ».

questions.question: By how much would the salary go up?
questions.explanation: « Le salaire augmenterait de dix pour cent seulement ».

questions.question: What does Julien decide, and why?
choices: To refuse, because of the hours.
To accept, because leading others is what he likes.
To ask for more money first.
questions.explanation: « C’est justement ça qui me plaît. Je vais accepter. ».

lines.fr: Mon chéri, ton père et moi avons lu ta lettre hier soir.
lines.en: My darling, your father and I read your letter last night.

lines.fr: Si tu veux partir en Australie après le lycée, nous ne t’en empêcherons pas.
lines.en: If you want to go to Australia after high school, we won't stop you.

lines.fr: Mais promets-nous de garder assez d’argent pour rentrer, au cas où tout irait mal.
lines.en: But promise us you'll keep enough money to come home, in case everything goes wrong.

lines.fr: Et écris-nous une fois par semaine, même si tu es très occupé.
lines.en: And write to us once a week, even if you're very busy.

questions.question: What did the parents do last night?
questions.explanation: « ton père et moi avons lu ta lettre hier soir ».

questions.question: What is their position on the Australia plan?
choices: They refuse to let him go.
They will not stop him going.
They want him to finish university first.
questions.explanation: « Si tu veux partir en Australie après le lycée, nous ne t’en empêcherons pas ».

questions.question: What must he promise?
choices: To keep enough money to come home.
To find a job over there.
To come back after a year.
To call as soon as he lands.
questions.explanation: « promets-nous de garder assez d’argent pour rentrer ».

questions.question: How often do they want him to write?
questions.explanation: « écris-nous une fois par semaine ».
